SamplePrepCanaryThresholds.description:
Operator-set acceptance bounds for linear vs methylGrapher comparison.

Stock Giraffe (``pangenome``) is an engineering comparator and does not use
these biological parity thresholds.

alignment_time_ratio_max.description: Max allowed (pangenome_wgbs alignment_ms / linear alignment_ms). Operator-set cost gate for the dual-mode compare experiment.
alignment_time_ratio_max.title: Alignment Time Ratio Max

cpg_coverage_min_fraction_of_linear.description: Minimum pangenome_wgbs CpG weighted-mean coverage as a fraction of linear. Hypothesis: usable CpG read support should not collapse vs linear.
cpg_coverage_min_fraction_of_linear.title: Cpg Coverage Min Fraction Of Linear

cpg_depth_thresholds.description: Operator-set coverage depths for optional H5 fraction-of-CpGs stats (e.g. [1, 5, 10]). Empty/unset skips H5 depth fractions.
cpg_depth_thresholds.title: Cpg Depth Thresholds

cpg_sites_min_fraction_of_linear.description: Minimum CpG sites called by pangenome_wgbs as a fraction of linear.
cpg_sites_min_fraction_of_linear.title: Cpg Sites Min Fraction Of Linear

duplication_rate_delta.description: Max absolute duplication-rate delta between linear and pangenome_wgbs.
duplication_rate_delta.title: Duplication Rate Delta

mapping_rate_delta.description: Max absolute mapping-rate delta between linear and pangenome_wgbs.
mapping_rate_delta.title: Mapping Rate Delta

mean_coverage_delta.description: Max absolute mean-coverage delta between linear and pangenome_wgbs.
mean_coverage_delta.title: Mean Coverage Delta

overlap_chromosomes.description: Optional chromosome list for overlap stats (e.g. ["1","2"]). Unset = all *-CG.h5 chromosomes present in both arms.
overlap_chromosomes.title: Overlap Chromosomes

overlap_mean_abs_meth_delta_max.description: Max mean |meth_wgbs − meth_linear| on overlapping CG sites. Operator-set methylation concordance gate.
overlap_mean_abs_meth_delta_max.title: Overlap Mean Abs Meth Delta Max

overlap_median_cov_ratio_max.description: Max median (wgbs_cov / linear_cov) on overlapping sites. Optional — MethylCall vs MethylExtractor coverage scales differ; leave unset unless comparing like-for-like extractors.
overlap_median_cov_ratio_max.title: Overlap Median Cov Ratio Max

overlap_meth_pearson_min.description: Minimum Pearson correlation of methylation fractions on overlapping CG sites. Operator-set concordance gate.
overlap_meth_pearson_min.title: Overlap Meth Pearson Min

overlap_recall_min_of_linear.description: Minimum fraction of linear CG H5 sites also present in pangenome_wgbs (shared chrom/pos). Operator-set site-overlap recall gate.
overlap_recall_min_of_linear.title: Overlap Recall Min Of Linear

require_alignment_qc.description: When false, missing alignment QC does not fail the mode report (science-only / report-only compares). Unset/true keeps the hard check.
require_alignment_qc.title: Require Alignment Qc

require_extraction_qc_pass.description: When true, every mode must pass extraction QC guardrails.
require_extraction_qc_pass.title: Require Extraction Qc Pass

require_read_level_patterns.description: When true, methylGrapher must emit non-empty patterns.h5 sidecars.
require_read_level_patterns.title: Require Read Level Patterns
